Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:10:1.english: Granted, according to Rav Asi - Who establishes that [mishnah] of "one writes" as [referring to] deeds of transfer.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:10:2.hebrew: מוקי - מתניתין בדלאו אקנייתא, ולהכי לא יחזיר, כדקאמר: איתרע ליה, וחיישי' דלמא אקרי וכתב, והוה ליה מוקדם, ולכן הופקר להשליכו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:10:2.english: He establishes - The mishna as [dealing with promissory notes that are] not deeds of transfer. And that is why [the finder] should not return [it], as he said: [Its status] was compromised, and we are concerned that perhaps it happened to be written [before the loan], and it is [thereby] an antedated [document], and therefore it was abandoned to be discarded.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:11:1.hebrew: לפרעון ולקנוניא - שמא פרעו, ומן הלוה נפל. והא דקא מודה "לא פרעתי" – עצה היא ביניהם של רמאות, לטרוף את הלקוחות שלקחו ממנו קרקע שלא באחריות, ויחלקו ביניהם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:11:1.english: Repayment and collusion - Perhaps he repaid it, and it fell from the borrower. And as for the fact that he admits, "I did not repay [it]" — it is a fraudulent scheme between them to seize [land from] the purchasers who bought land from him without a guarantee, and they will divide [it] between themselves.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:12:1.english: And according to Shmuel, who says - [This is stated] below.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:12:2.hebrew: לא חיישינן לפרעון - בשטר הנמצא, ואפילו אין חייב מודה, דאם איתא דפרעיה, מקרע הוה קרע ליה, דאמר שמואל לקמן (בבא מציעא דף טז:): המוצא שטר הקנאה בשוק יחזיר לבעלים. וכ"ש כשחייב מודה, מהאי טעמא גופיה, דמיום פריעתו הוא קורעו, הלכך ליכא למיחש לאחר זמן לקנוניא. מתני' במאי מוקי לה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:12:2.english: We do not suspect repayment - In [the case of] a found promissory note, and even when the debtor does not admit [the debt], for if it were so that he repaid it, he would have torn it up, as Shmuel says below (Bava Metzia 16b): "One who finds a deed of transfer in the marketplace shall return [it] to the owner [the creditor]." And all the more so when the debtor admits [the debt], for this very reason: that from the day of its repayment he tears it up; therefore, there is no reason to suspect collusion at a later time. [If so,] in what [case] does [Shmuel] establish our Mishnah?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:12:3.hebrew: הניחא כו' - ואי קשיא: על כרחך לא ס"ל כאביי, דאי כאביי סבירא ליה, מאי איריא שטר הקנאה? הא לאביי אין חילוק בין זה לזה, דאפילו דלאו הקנאה נמי יחזיר, הואיל ושמואל לא חייש לפרעון! לאו פירכא הוא, דמודה אביי בדלא מטא שטרא לידיה, כדאמרן; הלכך איכא למימר: כתב ללות ולא לוה לגמרי, ולא מטא לידיה מעולם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:12:3.english: This works out well, etc. - And if you object: Perforce [Shmuel] does not hold in accordance with Abaye, for if he held in accordance with Abaye, why did [he] specify a deed of transfer? Behold, according to Abaye there is no difference between this and that, as even [a document] that is not of transfer he should also return, since Shmuel is not concerned about repayment! — This is not a [valid] objection, for Abaye concedes in [a case] where the document did not reach [the creditor's] hand, as we said; therefore, it can be said: [Perhaps] he wrote [it] to borrow, but did not borrow at all, and it never reached [the creditor's] hand.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:13:1.hebrew: שמואל מוקי לה כשאין חייב מודה - בכתיבת השטר, שאומר לוה: לא כתבתי, ומזויף הוא. וא"ת: יתקיים בחותמיו? כיון שנפל, אתרע ליה, ואמרינן: מפני שפסול היה, לא נזהר, ומהמנינן ליה להאי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:13:1.english: Shmuel establishes it when the debtor does not admit - [That is, he does not admit] to the writing of the document, as the borrower says: "I did not write [it], and it is a forgery." And if you say: Let it be validated through its signatories? Since it fell, [its credibility] has been compromised, and we say: Because it was invalid, he was not careful [with it], and we believe this one.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:7:1.hebrew: דייתיקי - צואת שכיב מרע. ולשון דייתיקי: דא תיקו – זאת תיקום, דדברי שכיב מרע ככתובין וכמסורין דמי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:7:1.english: A will [deyatiki] - The will of a person on his deathbed [shekhiv mera]. And the term deyatiki [means] da teiku, [which means] "this shall stand" [zot takum], for the words of a person on his deathbed are considered as if written and handed over.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:7:2.english: A gift - A gift of a healthy person.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:7:3.english: And receipts - [Receipts for the] payment of a promissory note.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:8:1.hebrew: הני מילי היכא דמטא שטר לידיה - ואפילו לאחר זמן, זכו לו חותמיו לגבות מזמן הכתוב בו. ואי קשיא: הא דתנן (שביעית פ"י מ"ה) שטרי חוב המוקדמין פסולין והמאוחרין כשרין, במאי מוקי לה אביי? תריץ: במוקדמת כתיבתן לחתימתן, ולהכי פסולין, שבא לטרוף משעת כתיבה. א"נ, שכתבו וחתמוהו בתשרי, והם כתבו בתוכו ניסן, שהוא ראש השנה לשטרות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 13a:8:1.english: This applies where the document came into his hands - And even [if it came into his hands] after some time, its signatories acquired [the lien] for him to collect from the date written in it. And if you ask: That which we learned in a mishna (Shevi'it 10:5): "Predated promissory notes are invalid, and postdated [notes] are valid" — how does Abaye interpret it? Resolve [it]: [It refers to a case] where their writing preceded their signing, and for this reason they are invalid, because he comes to seize [property] from the time of writing. Alternatively: They wrote and signed it in Tishrei, but they wrote inside it "Nisan," which is the New Year for documents.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 13a:11:1.hebrew: היינו טעמא דחיישינן לפרעון ולקנוניא - וסברי רבנן: אחריות טעות סופר הוא, ולכך לא יחזיר אפילו אין בו אחריות. וכן לרב אסי תימה: אמאי קאמר משום דחיישינן לקנוניא? לימא משום דחיישינן שמא פרעו וכבר נמחל שעבודו, ועתה רוצה לחזור וללות בו כדי להרויח פשיטי דספרא, ומלוה נמי רוצה בדבר שיטרוף מזמן מוקדם! וי"ל: משום פשיטי דספרא לא יפסיד ללקוחות ממון מרובה. אף על גב דרב אסי חייש לכתב ללות ולא לוה ועתה רוצה ללות ומפסיד ללקוחות משום פשיטי דספרא — היינו משום שכבר נתן לסופר ואינו רוצה להפסיד, ועוד שסובר המלוה שיצא הקול משעת כתיבה. אבל כשלוה ופרע, לא הפסיד פשוט שנתן לסופר; ועוד, שירא המלוה ששמעו הפריעה, ואהלואה שנית לא נכתב השטר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 13a:11:1.english: This is the reason: that we suspect repayment and collusion - And the Rabbis hold that [the omission of] a property guarantee is a scribal error, and therefore [according to them] one should not return [the note] even if it does not contain a property guarantee. And similarly, according to Rav Asi, it is puzzling: Why does [Abaye] say [it is] because we suspect collusion? Let him say [it is] because we suspect that perhaps he repaid it and its lien was already canceled, and now he wants to borrow with it again in order to save the scribe's fee, and the lender also desires this so that he may repossess [property] from an earlier date! And one can answer: For [the sake of saving] the scribe's fee, [a borrower] would not cause purchasers to lose a large amount of money. Even though Rav Asi suspects [in our Mishnah] that he wrote [the document] to borrow and did not borrow, and now wants to borrow and causes purchasers to lose [their land] for the sake of the scribe's fee — that is because he already gave [payment] to the scribe and does not want to lose [it]; and furthermore, the lender assumes that a report spread from the time of the writing. However, when he borrowed and repaid, he did not lose the coin that he gave to the scribe; and furthermore, the lender is afraid that [people] heard of the repayment, and for a second loan the document was not written.
